name: Prepare RAG document datasets and review quality with Apify

parameters.content:
## Prepare documents for RAG
1. Create an Apify account and API token. Create an n8n Header Auth credential with name `Authorization` and value `Bearer YOUR_TOKEN`. Select it in all four HTTP request nodes (Start Apify report, Read completion status, Read QA, Read chunk operations).
2. Run the default fictional demo. Platform usage may apply.
3. To process your dataset, edit Choose input. Non-demo completed reports cost US$0.50 plus usage. The run has a US$0.75 maximum charge setting.
[Actor and documentation](https://apify.com/millgrah/rag-knowledge-base-sync-qa)

## Read-only report workflow
Requires a successful Actor run and COMPLETE status before reading QA and chunks. If the run does not finish in 60 seconds, inspect it in Apify Console; do not blindly retry. Keep your last eligible full manifest; only compare full authoritative snapshots with consistent settings. Never automatically apply DELETE suggestions. This template does not crawl, embed, or write to a vector database.
